issues: Source keyword "Intimidate" is not representable with the current documented keyword/reference set; add engine support for the intimidate keyword and keep it in `keywords`.

The fanfare is encoded as two separate abilities, which would try to deal 1 damage to both an enemy leader and an enemy follower; it should be a single fanfare that targets either an enemy leader or an enemy follower. Add engine support for a mixed target selector such as `enemyLeaderOrFollower` (or an equivalent choose-one targeting form), then encode one `dealDamage` effect for 1 damage to that target.

The Strike ability is missing the required target selection for the enemy follower. Encode `damageFollowerAndLeader` with a selected enemy follower target, or otherwise represent "Select an enemy follower on the field. Deal 1 damage to it and its leader."

The activated ability is encoded incorrectly as `grantLastWords` plus `dealDamageAllEnemies`; it should select a Commander follower on your field and give it a Strike ability that deals 2 damage to the enemy leader, not to each enemy leader and not as Last Words. Add engine support for granting a Strike-triggered ability to a target follower (for example a `grantStrike`/`grantTriggeredAbility` effect with target selector), then encode the activated effect to target a Commander follower on your field and grant `Strike: deal 2 damage to the enemy leader`.

The On Evolve effect searches and summons from the deck but omits the mandatory shuffle afterward. Encode the effect as a sequence with `tutorFromDeck` to `field` followed by `shuffleDeck`, or otherwise include the shuffle clause.

The condition is wrong: `discardedThisTurn` does not match "If any of your followers have been destroyed this turn". It should use a condition tracking allied followers destroyed this turn, then deal 4 instead of 1 to the selected enemy follower. Add engine support for a condition such as `allyFollowersDestroyedThisTurnMin` (or equivalent), and use it in the fanfare `if` effect.
